1.w: And Job proceeded again to take up his discourse, and he said,

2.w: “[As] God lives, [who] has turned aside my justice, and Shaddai [who] has embittered my soul—

3.w: that any of my breath still [is] in me, and the breath of God [is] in my nostrils,

4.w: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will not utter deceit.

5.w: Far be it from me that I justify you⁺; until I die, I will not turn aside my integrity from me.

6.w: My righteousness I hold fast, and I will not let go; my heart shall not reproach [me] in my days.

7.w: May my enemy be like the wicked, and the one rising up against me like the unjust.

8.w: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

9.w: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?

10.w: Indeed will he delight himself upon Shaddai? Will he call upon God at any time?

11.w: I will teach you⁺ about the hand of God; that which [is] with Shaddai I will not hide.

12.w: Behold, you⁺—all of you⁺—you⁺ have seen this; why then do you⁺ vainly utter this vanity?

13.w: This [is] the portion of the wicked man with God, and the inheritance of the ruthless [which] they receive from Shaddai.

14.w: If his sons should increase, [it is] for the sword; and his offspring shall not be satisfied [with] bread.

15.w: His survivor will be buried in death, and his widows will not lament.

16.w: Though he heaps up silver like the dust, and piles up clothing like the clay,

17.w: he may pile [it] up, but the righteous will wear [it], and the innocent will divide [his] silver.

18.w: He builds his house like the moth, and like a booth made [by] a watchman.

19.w: He lies down rich, but he shall not gather again; he opens his eyes, and he is not.

20.w: Terrors overwhelm him like waters; in the night a tempest steals him away.

21.w: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; and it sweeps him from his place.

22.w: And it hurls [itself] upon him, and does not spare; he urgently flees from its hand.

23.w: It claps its hands at him, and hisses at him from his place.
